audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was off by one row against its own whys on both layers: it gave Level 1 to 'Skill' where whys[0] says 'You spike first', gave Wukong Levels 2 and 3 where whys[1] and whys[2] hand them to Maokai, and gave Wukong both item rows where whys[5] and whys[6] call them skill windows.
audit.why: The mirror (maokai__wukong) already set the chart to Wukong / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Skill / Skill and the packet chart is identical.
audit.corrected: Six rows flipped as matched pairs on both layers with ratings re-scaled, and phases[0..6].why rewritten to describe the row each one now carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why was template text, and the level 6 row claimed 'Cyclone's double knockup wins every committed brawl'.
audit.why: Nature's Grasp is 130s at rank 1 across 3000 range — a gank and teamfight tool, which is exactly why level 6 is even rather than a Wukong spike.
audit.corrected: All seven phase whys rewritten to the real spikes with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. spikes[0].text literally reads 'Sapling Toss (W... his E)' — a garbled slot label shipped to the page. Twisted Advance was described only as a 'lock-on root' with its defining property missing. And Sap Magic's cooldown mechanic is absent everywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text on W: 'Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target.' He is UNTARGETABLE in flight, so burst timed onto his engage is wasted — that is the difference between your combo landing and hitting nothing. Sapling Toss is E, 18s at rank 1, 1100 range. And Sap Magic's heal cooldown 'is reduced each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell', so poking him with abilities actively accelerates his sustain — which is the real argument for early Grievous Wounds rather than a vague 'his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.corrected: Slot label fixed, untargetability stated in breakdown.cooldowns / dosFull[0].d / report[5].t / phases[1].why, and report[8].t now names Sap Magic and why it heals faster.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and two placeholder bullets.
audit.why: Twisted Advance 14s at rank 1 is the window the whole page is built on and it was never stated; Bramble Smash is 7s, Sapling Toss 18s.

notes: A garbled slot label — 'Sapling Toss (W... his E)' — was live on the page; fixed to E with its real cooldown and range. The decisive fact that was missing everywhere: Twisted Advance leaves Maokai untargetable during the dash, so burst timed onto his engage does nothing. Second missing fact: Sap Magic's heal cooldown drops every time he casts OR is hit by a spell, which is the concrete reason to buy Grievous Wounds early rather than 'his healing fights your pattern'. I did NOT claim Nature's Grasp blocks dashes: the kit carries a terrain flag but Riot's text describes an advancing wall that damages and roots, nothing about blocking paths. Chart restated from the mirror, not re-derived. No Wukong cooldowns used — ownerKit was null in this brief.
